That fits everything the #15185 dev reported (their script text is not on record), and the discipline already in `os-dev.md` :225–:227 is confirmed by measurement: the hash comparison caught both real non-restores and passed all 41 real restores, with no empty hash. `AGENTS.md` :52 / :369 owe no change. No text change, no PR; `os-dev.md` stays 403/403. Two measured facts left here for the next reader, ⛔ not carded (density edits on a file at its ceiling, no incident behind them): (1) `exec` replaces the shell image, so a trap armed before it never runs — never `exec` the child in an ablation script; (2) this harness reports the tool shell's own SIGSEGV as `Exit code 1` and a child's as a job-control 「Segmentation fault」 line with rc 139 — the trap marker plus the hash comparison is the discriminator, not the exit code. Also noted: `pnpm --filter X exec node …` stays alive after SIGTERM to the pnpm process — kill the recorded grandchild PID.
